meta.title: 新官上任女领导，怎么管老员工/老油条
meta.title_en: A New Female Leader vs. Veteran Employees
meta.topic: 职场管理 · 新领导上任行动序列

scenes.title_en: A Cautionary Tale: Talked to No Avail
scenes.context: 逐个谈心记了一本子真心话，结果表面支持的转头拆台、建议协调的拿你当枪使。
sentences: 我拿着小本本一个个喊到办公室谈心。
I called them into my office one by one, notebook in hand.
notebook（小本本）
那个说支持我的，转头就跟别人拆台。
The one who supported me to my face undercut me behind my back.
undercut（拆台）
这个大哥是拿我当枪使。
He was using me as a weapon.
use as a weapon（当枪使）
paraphrase: 「谈了个寂寞」的表达
All that talking bought me nothing real.
「当枪使」换说法
He got me to fight his battle for him.
scenes.speak: I called them into my office one by one, notebook in hand. The one who supported me to my face undercut me behind my back. He was using me as a weapon.

scenes.context: 先找直属领导要地图（目标）、钥匙（授权）、黑名单（权力结构）。
sentences: 先不要着急向下去谈。
Don't rush to talk to the team below you.
talk downward（向下谈）
去找你的领导要三样东西。
Ask your own boss for three things.
three things（三样东西）
一张地图、一把钥匙、一张黑名单。
A map, a key, and a blacklist.
blacklist（黑名单）
paraphrase: 「地图」的表达
A clear picture of what the boss wants you to achieve.
「向上要」换说法
Negotiate your mandate with your superior first.
scenes.speak: Don't rush to talk to the team below you. Ask your own boss for three things. A map, a key, and a blacklist.

scenes.context: 任命是一回事、授权是另一回事，要问清楚哪些事能拍板哪些要请示。
sentences: 任命是一回事，授权又是另外一回事。
Being appointed is one thing; real authority is another.
appointed（任命）
哪些事我是能拍板的？
Which decisions am I authorized to make?
authorized（授权）
哪些事我得先请示？
Which ones do I need to escalate first?
escalate（请示）
paraphrase: 「拍板」的表达
Decide on my own without asking.
「管理权限」换说法
Know exactly the boundaries of your power.
scenes.speak: Being appointed is one thing; real authority is another. Which decisions am I authorized to make? Which ones do I need to escalate first?

scenes.context: 黑名单是权力结构：刺头、关系户、意见领袖；前两周少表态多观察。
sentences: 谁是能干活但脾气臭的刺头？
Who's the sharp-tongued worker who gets things done?
sharp-tongued（脾气臭）
谁是动不了的关系户？
Who's the protected hire nobody can touch?
protected hire（关系户）
前面两周少表态多观察。
For the first two weeks, talk less and observe more.
observe（观察）
paraphrase: 「少表态多观察」的表达
Hold your opinions and gather facts first.
「意见领袖」换说法
Who actually drives the team's opinions?
scenes.speak: Who's the sharp-tongued worker who gets things done? Who's the protected hire nobody can touch? For the first two weeks, talk less and observe more.

scenes.context: 别天天说「老板的意思」，拿连续结果说话，女性管理者尤其如此。
sentences: 不要天天张嘴闭嘴就是老板的意思。
Stop leaning on "the boss says" all the time.
lean on（依赖）
你只需要干三件事。
You only need to do three things.
three things（三件事）
上级喜欢你、规则清楚、结果拿得出来。
Boss likes you, rules are clear, and you deliver results.
deliver results（拿结果）
paraphrase: 「拿结果说话」的表达
Let your track record speak for you.
「重新被评估」换说法
People will rethink you once results pile up.
scenes.speak: Stop leaning on "the boss says" all the time. You only need to do three things. Boss likes you, rules are clear, and you deliver results.

practice: 新官上任别急着做什么？
Don't rush into one-on-one talks with the team.
A map, a key (authority), and a blacklist (power structure).
Which decisions I own and which I escalate.
pitfalls: 不了解情况就改容易翻车。
footer_notes: ASR 校正：转录中「职属名堂/南原云里」为音误，按语境修正；「时间轴数」修正为「时间久了」。
